events.text: Village incorporated into the Ottoman Empire together with all of Palestine.

evidence.quote: The village was incorporated into the Ottoman Empire in 1517

events.text: Village listed in tax registers within Jabal Qubal nahiya, Nablus liwa.

evidence.quote: in 1596 it appeared in the tax registers as being in the nahiya of Jabal Qubal

events.text: Village noted as Serata, part of Jurat Merda district south of Nablus.

evidence.quote: In 1838 it was noted as a village Serata , part of the Jurat Merda district

events.text: Village came under Jordanian rule after the 1948 war and 1949 armistice agreements.

evidence.quote: after the 1949 Armistice Agreements , Sarta came under Jordanian rule

events.text: Village placed under Israeli occupation after the Six-Day War.

evidence.quote: Since the Six-Day War in 1967 , Sarta has been under Israeli occupation

undated_mentions: Israel confiscated 353 dunams of Sarta village land for the Barkan settlement (no date given)
